messages:
pagerbot: Pager: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed on inference-gateway-prod. Alert rate spike starting ~2m ago. Paging josh_oncall.

josh_oncall: I'm oncall — joining bridge and collecting context. Which service shows the 5xx?

eli: model-runner service (model-runner-3) producing segfaults and OOM lines in kernel logs. Seeing repeated container restarts.

sam_runtime: confirming: GPU OOM + a segfault in attention kernel in runtime v1.9.2. Crash loop on node gpu-uk-07.

maya: rolling quick traffic shift to fallback model (runtimes/fallback-small) in us-west-2 to reduce customer impact. Doing gradual 50% -> 100% if metrics look good.

josh_oncall: do the reroute now, please. Post the command you run.

maya: executed: `kubectl apply -f reroute/fallback-policy.yaml --namespace=prod` and updated route weight -> fallback-small=100%.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: additional replicas requested for model-runner (6->12).

ann_support: initial triage from support: multiple customers reported timeouts and 503s on generation endpoints over last 10m. Top affected: acct-alpha, acct-beta. Outreach queued.

eli: grabbing logs and core dumps now. Example tail of runtime log:
```
[2026-08-12T02:14:35Z] model-runner[pid=4123]: runtime: kernel_attention.c:line 842: segfault
[2026-08-12T02:14:35Z] OOM killer invoked on /dev/nvidia0
[2026-08-12T02:14:36Z] container runtime: restarting container (exit code 139)
```

sam_runtime: root cause candidate: quantized attention kernel misinteraction with new CUDA driver patch on nodes deployed in last 48h. Matches recent prod roll.

eli: collecting core dump: `gdb -c core.4123 --batch -ex 'thread apply all bt' > /tmp/core-backtrace-4123.txt` then upload to S3: `aws s3 cp /tmp/core-backtrace-4123.txt s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3055556789/`

josh_oncall: good. Immediate mitigations: 1) reroute traffic to fallback (done), 2) cordon + drain affected node gpu-uk-07, 3) scale up unaffected pool, 4) hotpatch a build that disables the new kernel path.

sam_runtime: pushed hotpatch image `runtime:hotpatch-3055` to dedicated pool and started canary on model-runner-canary. Command: `./deploy.sh runtime:hotpatch-3055 --canary 3`

leah_sre: cordoned node gpu-uk-07 and evicted pods: `kubectl cordon gpu-uk-07 && kubectl drain gpu-uk-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`. No immediate error on drains.

ops-bot: node gpu-uk-07 status: cordoned. Pods rescheduled to gpu-uk-02,gpu-uk-05.

maya: after reroute to fallback and canary started, 5xx rate dropped from ~18% -> ~3% in the last 6m. Latency slightly up but within SLO.

ann_support: updating impacted customers: sent initial note to acct-alpha and acct-beta details + ETA for mitigation.

sam_runtime: hotpatch canary logs show no segfaults for 10m. If stable for 15m we can promote.

josh_oncall: agreement: promote hotpatch to remaining fleet, continue to monitor. Postmortem owner assigned (sam_runtime) and communications lead (ann_support).

eli: captured artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3055556789/ (logs, backtraces, node metadata).

leah_sre: temporary mitigation timeline: reroute + cordon applied at +2m. Hotpatch canary started +8m. Full promotion started +22m.

maya: promoting hotpatch: `./deploy.sh runtime:hotpatch-3055 --promote --confirm`

ops-bot: Promotion: runtime:hotpatch-3055 -> model-runner-prod completed. Rolling restart initiated.

eli: after promotion, residual 5xx under 1% and stabilizing. No more OOM signals on remaining nodes.

josh_oncall: declaring incident: mitigated. Moving to monitoring state. Will keep bridge open for 30m for validation. Severity set to S2.

ann_support: customers notified that failover and fix applied, follow-up PM with postmortem promised.

sam_runtime: next steps: reproduce locally with same CUDA/kernel version, add regression test and gating to rollout. Filing PR with guard rails.

josh_oncall: great work. Final checks: confirm SLO impact, update incident timeline and hand off to postmortem team.

pagerbot: Incident INC-3055556789: mitigated -> monitoring. Bridge closed in 30m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:

leah_sre: leaving note: if any recurring segfaults appear, re-open paging and escalate to infra on-call.
